description.en-US:
Generate a QR code for whatever you are looking at — the current page, a link, an image, or selected text — then scan it with your phone.

It cleans the URL first. Tracking parameters like utm_source, fbclid and gclid are stripped before encoding, so the link your phone opens is the one you meant to share. The shorter URL also makes a sparser code that scans more easily.

It acts on what you selected. Select a phone number, email address or coordinate pair and the code becomes tel:, mailto: or geo: — so the scanning phone offers to dial, compose or map it rather than showing inert text. Detection is deliberately reluctant: prices, dates, version numbers, ISBNs and part numbers are left alone, because a wrong guess is worse than plain text. The raw words are always offered alongside, never instead of them.

It can link to the passage, not just the page. Selecting text also offers a link that scrolls the reader straight to that passage. Long selections encode only their first and last few words, which finds the same text while keeping the code far sparser.

Tuned to actually scan. Long URLs produce dense codes that phone cameras struggle with off a screen. Clean QR lowers the error-correction level to keep the code readable instead of letting it get denser, and says so when it does rather than changing your setting silently.

Entirely offline. No network requests, no host permissions, no analytics. The code is generated on your machine and never leaves it.

• Right-click any page, link, image, frame or selection (Firefox desktop)
• Keyboard shortcut: Alt+Shift+Q, which is Option+Shift+Q on macOS
• Copy the image, copy the cleaned URL, copy as Markdown, or save as PNG or SVG
• Show the code full-screen when it has to be scanned from across the room
• On Firefox for Android, share the code straight to the system share sheet
• Remember recent codes if you want them — off by default, since it records what you encoded
• Follows your light or dark theme — the code itself always stays dark-on-white, since inverted codes fail to scan
